mapper.sql: c.collection_id, c.sale_id, c.sale_no, c.dept_id, d.dept_name, c.member_id, c.customer_name, c.sale_amount, c.paid_amount, c.unpaid_amount, c.age_days, c.age_bucket, c.collection_status, c.priority_level, c.owner_id, c.owner_name, c.promised_pay_date, c.promised_amount, c.next_follow_time, c.last_follow_time, c.follow_count
mapper.select: select * from finance_receivable_collection where collection_id = #{collectionId} and del_flag = '0'
select * from finance_receivable_collection where sale_id = #{saleId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into finance_receivable_collection (sale_id, sale_no, dept_id, member_id, customer_name, sale_amount, paid_amount, unpaid_amount, age_days, age_bucket, collection_status, priority_level, owner_id, owner_name, promised_pay_date, promised_amount, next_follow_time, last_follow_time, follow_count, source_task_id, tenant_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{saleId}, #{saleNo}, #{deptId}, #{memberId}, #{customerName}, #{saleAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{unpaidAmount}, #{ageDays}, #{ageBucket}, #{collectionStatus}, #{priorityLevel}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerName}, #{promisedPayDate}, #{promisedAmount}, #{nextFollowTime}, #{lastFollowTime}, #{followCount}, #{sourceTaskId}, #{tenantId}, coalesce(#{delFlag}, '0'), #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})

insert into finance_receivable_collection_log (collection_id, old_status, new_status, follow_note, promised_pay_date, promised_amount, next_follow_time, operator_id, operator_name, tenant_id, create_time) values (#{collectionId}, #{oldStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{followNote}, #{promisedPayDate}, #{promisedAmount}, #{nextFollowTime}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{tenantId}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update finance_receivable_collection c join fin_sale_record r on c.sale_id = r.sale_id set c.paid_amount = coalesce(r.paid_amount, 0), c.unpaid_amount = r.sale_amount - coalesce(r.paid_amount, 0), c.collection_status = case when r.sale_amount - coalesce(r.paid_amount, 0) <= 0 then 'PAID' else c.collection_status end where c.collection_id = #{collectionId}
